items.title: Denise Morel Interview, 1965-05-07
items.q: He plays well with the clarinet.

ctx.x: What happened to people like Maxim Sari? What is he doing now?

Oh, he is very commercial. He is a very proud. He plays well with the clarinet. And he does good arrangements, I believe, because he has done long studies in the music Conservatory of Paris. But he lives with his music, and it's really quite commercial. But it's not bad, when he comes to the music. Well, he is certainly in the orchestra, in the only, in the two commercial orchestras, in the Nouvelle Orléans, in Paris, there is him and Luther, and I think that now, he is better than Luther, as well. Because Luther…
Do you know, I don't know how to pronounce it. Claude Boling?
